title: Extend depth sweep: DEPTH=10 -> 12
description: Set DEPTH=12 (model_dim 640->768, 6 heads); also reduced DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 128->64 (more grad_accum_steps) to stay within VRAM headroom.
reflection: val_bpb regressed to 1.016037, worse than depth=10's 1.002279 and even worse than the original depth=8 baseline of 1.014027. This shows depth=10 was at or past the local optimum for this 5-minute time budget -- further depth increase is a net loss, likely because the smaller device batch size (needed to fit VRAM) and/or larger model reduces effective tokens-per-second and steps taken in the fixed wall-clock budget. Recommend not pushing depth further; a finer probe at DEPTH=11 (with device batch size kept at 128 if it fits) might be worth one more small experiment, but expect diminishing or negative returns. VRAM at depth=12/batch=64 was only 48990MB, well under the depth=10/batch=128 66.5GB, suggesting batch size reduction was overly conservative and may have hurt throughput -- a future depth=11 test should try to keep DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE=128 if it fits to avoid confounding the depth change with a batch-size change.
